Setup.Name: Parsing logs with grok
Setup.Description: A simple log parser that will use the grok parser to process a log message.

MqttData.Payload: 2026-01-31T15:42Z INFO ServerA This is a test.

Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Server logs"
    Description: "Collect all log messages from the server."
    Mqtt:
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/log"
    Otel:
      Attributes:
        - Key: Location
          Value: MainServerRoom
      Logs:
        - PayloadType: Json
          Transform: "GROK('%{DATA:otel_timestamp} %{DATA:otel_loglevel} %{DATA:server_name} %{GREEDYDATA:otel_message}')"
